cards.title: Lions + Texans
cards.tier: Lower payout; higher raw price-implied probability than the reserves

legs.evidence: StatsNext (through Nov 5, updated Nov 7, 2:54 PM ET) and Football Database list Detroit 29.0 points/game (3rd) and 395.4 yards/game (1st); Miami 16.7 points/game (31st) and 290.0 yards/game (27th). ESPN scoreboard lists Detroit 5-2 and Miami 1-6 for the 1:00 PM EST Hard Rock Stadium game. Jared Goff is Detroit’s season passing leader and is not listed with a Week 9 game designation on the official injury report. Official NFL.com Week 9 inactives (article updated 11:43 AM EST) do not include Amon-Ra St. Brown among Detroit’s seven inactive players, the standard indication he is active after Sunday-morning Rapoport and Pelissero reports that he was expected to play / good to go.
legs.remaining_checks: Official Lions inactives: CB D.J. Reed, EDGE DJ Wonnum, C Cade Mays, RB Jacob Saylors, TE Jordan Meeks, DL Mekhi Wingo and EDGE Ahmed Hassanein. Saylors, previously questionable (neck), is inactive. Jack Campbell and Kerby Joseph remain listed OUT on the official injury report but were not among those seven names. Official Dolphins inactives include RB Jaylen Wright, matching Rapoport’s earlier report he would not play; also inactive are WR Jalen Tolbert, CB Marcellas Dial Jr., CB Reese Taylor, G Christian Haynes, T Chukwuebuka Godrick and TE Justin Joly. Kaytron Allen and Malik Herring, listed questionable on the injury report, are not on Miami’s inactive list. Houston’s 4:05 PM EST inactives are still ahead, typically around 2:35 PM EST. Open-Meteo near 1:00 PM EST: about 84°F, wind 2 mph, gusts 4 mph, precip 0%. Live PA/MD prices and live selection acceptance remain unverified.
legs.lineup_status: Official NFL.com inactives for the 1:00 PM EST game remain posted (article updatedDate 11:43 AM EST / dateModified 11:44 AM EST; unchanged this review). Amon-Ra St. Brown is not on Detroit’s inactive list. Jacob Saylors is inactive.
legs.weather_status: Outdoor Hard Rock Stadium. Rechecked Open-Meteo this review: ~84°F, light wind (~2 mph, gusts ~4 mph), precip about 0% at 1:00 PM EST. Not a live stadium observation; refresh again before kickoff.

legs.evidence: StatsNext/Football Database list Houston 23.6 points/game versus 14.1 for the Chargers (32nd). cards.title: Rams + Broncos
cards.tier: Higher payout, lower raw price-implied probability

legs.evidence: Official Week 9 report does not list Matthew Stafford with a game designation, and he is not on the official Rams inactive list. Washington receivers Dyami Brown and Treylon Burks were listed OUT on the Week 9 report; official Commanders inactives include Burks. That supports further review of a healthier starting-QB/receiving comparison, not a quantified edge. ESPN lists the Rams 4-4 at Washington 2-4-1, 1:00 PM EST at Northwest Stadium.
legs.remaining_checks: Official Rams inactives: QB Ty Simpson (emergency third QB), CB Trent McDuffie, LS Joe Cardona, OLB Darryl Peterson III, OL Bill Murray, OL Keagen Trost and OLB Desjuan Johnson. McDuffie, previously questionable, is inactive; Cardona, previously doubtful, is also inactive. Jaylen Watson remains listed OUT on the injury report and was not among the seven names. Kamren Curl, Jordan Whittington and Colby Parkinson are not on the inactive list. Official Commanders inactives: WR Treylon Burks, QB Athan Kaliakmanis (emergency third QB), CB Fabian Moreau, CB Isaac Yiadom and G Tanoa Togiai. Jayden Daniels and Jer’Zhan Newton are not listed as inactive; do not presume a quarterback absence. Dyami Brown remains listed OUT on the injury report and was not among those Commanders names. This remains the weaker conditional reserve because the Rams secondary is now without McDuffie after Watson was already out. The 12:00 PM EST snapshot moved LAR from -220 to -230 after those official lists. Open-Meteo near 1:00 PM EST: about 60°F, wind 9 mph, gusts 15 mph, precip 0%.
legs.lineup_status: Official NFL.com inactives for the 1:00 PM EST game remain posted (article updatedDate 11:43 AM EST; unchanged this review). Trent McDuffie and Joe Cardona are inactive. Kamren Curl, Jordan Whittington and Colby Parkinson are not on the Rams list.
legs.weather_status: Outdoor Northwest Stadium. Rechecked Open-Meteo this review: ~60°F, wind about 9 mph, gusts about 15 mph, no rain in the hourly forecast at 1:00 PM EST. Refresh again before kickoff.

legs.evidence: ESPN lists Denver 6-2 at Carolina 3-4, 1:00 PM EST at Bank of America Stadium. Official Panthers inactives include G Damien Lewis, OLB Jaelan Phillips, LB Bobby Okereke and CB Will Lee III, matching the Week 9 outs, plus QB Haynes King (emergency third QB), RB AJ Dillon and DT TeRah Edwards. Bo Nix is Denver’s listed passing leader and is not on the Broncos inactive list. Record and opponent absences are descriptive support, not a calibrated win probability. Counterevidence: Carolina’s season offense is 25.4 points/game (9th) and 363.7 yards/game (9th) versus Denver’s 21.5 (21st) and 273.0 (30th) on the NFL.com game page.
legs.remaining_checks: Official Broncos inactives: QB Sam Ehlinger (emergency third QB), WR Lil’Jordan Humphrey, S Talanoa Hufanga, S Brandon Jones, CB Kris Abrams-Draine, OL Kage Casey and TE Dallen Bentley. Hufanga, previously questionable, is inactive along with the already-out Jones and Abrams-Draine. Pat Bryant and Dondrea Tillman are not on the inactive list; the Broncos’ official inactives article also says both are active. Eyioma Uwazurike remains listed OUT on the injury report but was not among Denver’s seven names. The confirmed Hufanga absence is a defensive hit on an already thinner secondary. The 12:00 PM EST snapshot moved DEN from -152 to -164 after those official lists. Open-Meteo near 1:00 PM EST: about 65°F, wind 8 mph, gusts 11 mph, precip 0%.
legs.lineup_status: Official NFL.com inactives for the 1:00 PM EST game remain posted (article updatedDate 11:43 AM EST; unchanged this review). Talanoa Hufanga, Brandon Jones and Kris Abrams-Draine are inactive. Pat Bryant and Dondrea Tillman are not on the Broncos list.
